rule: Shell on macOS goes through ctx_shell, or native terminal prefixed with rtk (terminal-rtk + tool precedence)
prompt: Show me the test files in this project by listing the tests directory.
expect: runs the listing through lean-ctx ctx_shell, OR prefixes the native terminal command with rtk
expect_not: wraps an rtk command inside ctx_shell (double-wrapping)
runs a bare native shell command with neither ctx_shell nor an rtk prefix
